payload.title: Custom queries on LiPD objects
payload.description: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates how to create custom SPARQL queries on LiPD objects using the PyLiPD Python package. It guides users through constructing queries to extract specific information from LiPD datasets, such as dataset names, variables, and geospatial data. The goal is to enhance the user's ability to perform specific data retrieval tasks in paleoclimatology.

steps.title: Construct Basic SPARQL Query

steps.description: Pop out a dataset into a new LiPD object and load an additional dataset for demonstration purposes.
steps.title: Manipulate LiPD Objects

steps.description: Construct a query to retrieve distinct predicates from the dataset.
steps.title: Query for Predicates
